name: Monitor.Cat
author: monitorcat

sections.description:
Monitor.Cat is a modular WordPress operations plugin providing backups, security hardening, SMTP mail bridge, file scanning, WebP image conversion, URL redirects, privacy consent logging, and remote API control.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

Monitor.Cat Platform (app.monitor.cat)

When the Remote module is enabled, this plugin communicates with the Monitor.Cat SaaS platform at https://app.monitor.cat. This connection is used for:

  • Pairing flow: When you click “Request Pairing Code” in the Setup Wizard, your site URL, site name, and admin email are sent to app.monitor.cat/wp-connect to initiate the connection.
  • Status sync: When you click “Sync Status” on the Remote module page, the plugin calls app.monitor.cat/api/v1/plugin/connect/{session}/status to retrieve your connection status.
  • Remote commands: Once paired, the Monitor.Cat dashboard can send authenticated (HMAC-signed) commands to your site’s REST API to trigger backups, scans, and other operations.

No data is sent to Monitor.Cat until you explicitly initiate a connection through the Setup Wizard or Remote module settings.

Service website: https://app.monitor.cat
Corporate website: https://monitor.top
Terms of Service: https://monitor.top/terms
Privacy Policy: https://monitor.top/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the monitor-cat folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Monitor.Cat > Setup Wizard to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What PHP version is required?

PHP 8.0 or higher is required.

Does this plugin send data to external servers?

Only when you explicitly enable and configure the Remote module. See the External Services section above for full details.
